caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane composed mainly of metallic-looking objects in shades of brown, gold, and black. The central feature is an arrow, detailed with stylized feathers on the left and a pointed tip on the right, with the words "HIGH SCHOOL" cut out in uppercase letters along the arrow’s shaft. The arrow is horizontally mounted atop a vertical rod, which is connected to a spherical element set over a pyramidal base. Below the arrow is a compass rose, made of thin black rods that form a cross, with each arm labeled by a gold letter representing cardinal directions: "N", "S", "E", and "W". The letters “S” and “W” are positioned to the left, while “E” and “N” are to the right of the rod. Decorative curls are present where the compass arms intersect. There is a thin rectangular border drawn around the vignette, and in the upper left corner, there is a small inset line drawing showing a simplified version of the weather vane. The background is off-white, and the illustration appears to be done in colored pencil or watercolor with precise lines and shading.
title: Weather Vane
